name: Fortified Keep
text: Bow: produce 2 gold. Your provinces have +1 Strength.

name: Festival of Lanterns
text: When revealed: you draw 2 Fate cards.

name: Typhoon
text: When revealed: bow every Personality your opponent controls.

name: Plague
text: When revealed: destroy every Personality with Chi 1 or less.

name: Ashigaru
text: Follower. Attach to a Personality you control: +1 Force.

name: Light Infantry
text: Follower. Attach to a Personality you control: +2 Force.

name: Heavy Infantry
text: Follower. Attach to a Personality you control: +3 Force.

name: Light Cavalry
text: Follower. Attach to a Personality you control: +2 Force.

name: Katana
text: Item. Attach to a Personality you control: +1 Force.

name: Ancestral Sword
text: Item. Attach to a Personality you control: +2 Force, +1 Chi.

name: Lacquered Armor
text: Item. Attach to a Personality you control: +1 Force, +1 Chi.

name: Banzai!
text: Battle: one of your units in this battle gets +2 Force.

name: Ambush
text: Battle, defending only: one of your defending units gets +3 Force.

name: Archers' Volley
text: Battle: destroy an opposing Follower with Force 2 or less in this battle.

name: Rally the Troops
text: Battle: straighten one of your bowed units in this battle.

name: Strategic Withdrawal
text: Battle: one of your units leaves the battle and goes home bowed.

name: Challenge
text: Open: one of your unbowed Personalities challenges an opposing Personality to a duel.

name: Insult
text: Open: bow an opposing Personality. Its controller loses 1 honor.

name: Hired Killer
text: Open: pay 3 gold and lose 3 honor: destroy an opposing Personality with Personal Honor 2 or less.

name: Forced March
text: Limited: straighten one of your Personalities.

name: Armor of Earth
text: Spell. Battle, bow a Shugenja you control: one of your units in this battle gets +3 Force.

name: Fires of Purity
text: Spell. Battle, bow a Shugenja you control: destroy an opposing Follower with Force 3 or less in this battle.

name: Blessing of the Fortunes
text: Spell. Limited, bow a Shugenja you control: gain 2 honor.

name: Ring of Earth
text: Limited. Play only if you control four or more Holdings.

name: Ring of Water
text: Limited. Play only if you control four or more Personalities.

name: Ring of Fire
text: Limited. Play only if you won a battle this turn.

name: Ring of Air
text: Limited. Play only if your Family Honor is 20 or more.

name: Ring of the Void
text: Limited. Play only if you have three other Rings in play.
